fact: Shuushar the Awakened is a Kuo-toan monitor who has experienced enlightenment and now serves as a guide and moral compass for the party, advocating for understanding over violence and emphasizing the legitimacy of the Sea Mother as the traditional faith.
source_quote: Shuushar sighs, 'Such an unnecessary battle. Why would this be happening?'

subject: Shuushar the Awakened
fact: Shuushar the Awakened is a Kuo-toan monitor who provides structured organization over Kuo-toan groups and believes in opening oneself to all points of view before making judgments. He is deeply devoted to the Sea Mother and opposes the Deep Father cult.

subject: Shuushar the Awakened
fact: Shuushar the Awakened says ‘Yes’ to continuing.
source_quote: “Yes,” the Shuushar the Awakened says.

subject: Shuushar the Awakened
fact: Shuushar the Awakened says, 'Yes.'
source_quote: Yes, the Shuushar the Awakened says.

subject: Topsy
fact: Topsy asks if the kuo-toan problems are the party’s concern.
source_quote: “I hear about your problems, and that sounds like a you problem, not like a me problem. What can we help with you?”

subject: Topsy
fact: Topsy is a disengaged, cynical party member who sees the Kuo-toan conflict as a 'you problem' and questions the party’s involvement, reflecting a detached, survivalist attitude.
source_quote: Topsy asks, 'I hear about your problems, and that sounds like a you problem, not like a me problem. What can we help with you?'

subject: Zalthir
fact: Zalthir is a results-oriented member of the party who focuses on material compensation, pressing the archpriest for rewards and showing little interest in theological debates.
source_quote: Zalthir shouts to the archpriest, 'You said reward?'

subject: Zalthir
fact: Zalthir looks at Ploopploopeen unimpressed when she offers to use them as bait.
source_quote: Zalthir looks at her, unimpressed.

subject: Zalthir
fact: Zalthir shouts to the archpriest to confirm the reward.
source_quote: Zalthir shouts to the archpriest, “You said reward?”

subject: 500 gold
fact: Ploopploopeen promises 500 gold as a reward for the party’s aid.
source_quote: The archpriest promises 500 gold and two potions of healing.

subject: Bloody chum
fact: Bloody chum is the sacrificial residue from the Deep Father cult’s blood offerings, cast into the Darklake. It is consumed by an unknown entity, suggesting a deeper, possibly primordial, connection to Leemooggoogoon the Deep Father.

subject: guides to navigate the Darklake
fact: Ploopploopeen offers guides to navigate the Darklake as part of the reward.
source_quote: “Two boats and guides to navigate the Darklake?”

subject: hand-held crossbows
fact: A collection of hand-held crossbows, combined with a united team, can create a powerful enough force to take down a formidable group of enemies.
source_quote: a collection of hand-held crossbows, combined with a united team, can create a powerful enough force to take down even a formidable group of enemies.

subject: Hand-held Crossbows
fact: Hand-held crossbows, when used in coordinated formation by a united team, can generate enough force to take down formidable groups of enemies, suggesting tactical synergy over brute strength.
source_quote: In the end, they realize that a collection of hand-held crossbows, combined with a united team, can create a powerful enough force to take down even a formidable group of enemies.

subject: liquid from kuo-toan bodies
fact: Only the application of strength can free a weapon from the liquid glue.
source_quote: Only the application of strength can from a weapon from the glue.

subject: liquid from kuo-toan bodies
fact: The body of the kuo-toans releases a liquid that causes any melee weapon to stick to their bodies.
source_quote: the body of the Kuo-toans releases a particular liquid that causes any melee weapon to stick to their bodies.

subject: Potions of Healing
fact: Two potions of healing are offered by Ploopploopeen as part of the reward package, indicating the party’s anticipated exposure to combat and injury during the infiltration mission.
source_quote: The archpriest promises 500 gold and two potions of healing.

subject: two boats
fact: Ploopploopeen offers two boats as part of the reward after the party is unimpressed with the initial offer.
source_quote: “Two boats and guides to navigate the Darklake?”

subject: Two Boats and Guides
fact: Two boats and experienced guides to navigate the Darklake are offered as part of the reward, essential for the party’s movement through the Kuo-toan-controlled waterways and their infiltration of the Deep Father’s stronghold.
source_quote: 'Two boats and guides to navigate the Darklake?' The escapees nod in agreement.

subject: two potions of healing
fact: Ploopploopeen promises two potions of healing as a reward for the party’s aid.
source_quote: The archpriest promises 500 gold and two potions of healing.

subject: reward offer
fact: The archpriest promises 500 gold and two potions of healing, then adds two boats and guides to navigate the Darklake.
source_quote: The archpriest promises 500 gold and two potions of healing. But she sees how they are unimpressed, “Two boats and guides to navigate the Darklake?”

subject: Bloppblippodd’s Vision
fact: The source and validity of Bloppblippodd’s vision of Leemooggoogoon are unknown — was it divine revelation, psychic trauma, or manipulation by an external force? The party may need to confront her directly to uncover the truth.
source_quote: She has backed up her claims with a tremendous increase in magical power, and new followers have flocked to her.

subject: disruption of rituals
fact: Ploopploopeen wants the party to disrupt the upstart faction’s rituals so her true believers can cut off the head of the cult.
source_quote: Ploopploopeen wants them to disrupt the upstart faction’s rituals, allowing his true believers of the Sea Mother to cut off the head of the cult.

subject: infiltration plan
fact: Ploopploopeen plans to use the party as infiltrators disguised as sacrifices to disrupt the Deep Father’s rituals.
source_quote: Ploopploopeen will offer them as a “token of peace and reconciliation” to get closer to the archpriest of the Deep Father — except the adventurers will not be helpless prisoners but infiltrators.

subject: Ploopploopeen's daughter Bloppblippodd
fact: Bloppblippodd's vision of Leemooggoogoon the Deep Father and her claim of new divine authority are unresolved and central to the factional conflict.
source_quote: A few weeks ago, Bloppblippodd, Ploopploopeen’s daughter, experienced a powerful vision of 'Leemooggoogoon the Deep Father,' proclaiming him the new god of her people. She has backed up her claims with a tremendous increase in magical power, and new followers have flocked to her.

subject: Shuushar’s Philosophical Droning
fact: Shuushar’s tendency to speak at length about openness, perspective, and judgment may delay decisive action — the party must decide whether his wisdom is vital or a dangerous distraction.
source_quote: Shuushar continues to drone on but thankfully walks away.

subject: Shuushar’s transformation
fact: Shuushar has shifted from a monitor focused on control to a seeker of understanding. His growing openness to Bloppblippodd’s perspective may signal a deeper internal conflict or a hidden connection to the Deep Father cult.

subject: The Daughter’s Loyalty
fact: It is unclear whether Bloppblippodd is truly devoted to Leemooggoogoon or is being manipulated — the party may need to confront her directly to determine if she is a zealot, a pawn, or a victim.
source_quote: She has backed up her claims with a tremendous increase in magical power.

subject: The Deep Father’s True Nature
fact: The origin and nature of Leemooggoogoon the Deep Father remain unclear — whether a false god, a primordial entity, or a corrupted manifestation — and the party must determine if the cult is truly evil or merely a new evolution of faith.
source_quote: Ploopploopeen says, 'It is Leemooggoogoon the Deep Father that is the real evil!'

subject: The Deep Father's true nature
fact: The origin and true nature of Leemooggoogoon the Deep Father remain mysterious. His emergence coincides with Bloppblippodd’s vision and surge in magical power, raising questions about whether he is a genuine deity, a corrupted entity, or a manifestation of collective madness.

subject: The entity in the Darklake
fact: Something consumes the bloody chum cast into the Darklake. Its identity and allegiance are unknown—whether it serves the Deep Father, is an ancient force awakened by the cult, or is a trick of perception.

subject: The identity of the entity consuming the bloody chum
fact: The entity consuming the bloody chum in the Darklake is unspecified and mysterious.
source_quote: The followers of the Deep Father have been making an increasing number of offerings on his altar — killing blood sacrifices then casting bloody chum into the waters of the Darklake, where it is consumed by … something.

subject: The Party’s Role as Infiltrators
fact: The party has been offered as bait by Ploopploopeen to infiltrate the Deep Father cult — their success or failure may determine the balance of power among the Kuo-toans, and their moral alignment may be tested by becoming tools of religious warfare.
source_quote: Ploopploopeen will offer them as a 'token of peace and reconciliation' to get closer to the archpriest of the Deep Father — except the adventurers will not be helpless prisoners but infiltrators.

subject: The Sea Mother’s silence
fact: Despite Ploopploopeen’s claims of divine favor, the Sea Mother has not directly intervened in the schism. This raises doubt about whether her power is fading, or if she is testing her followers through conflict.

subject: The Unseen Consumer in the Darklake
fact: Something unseen consumes the bloody chum cast into the Darklake — a possible avatar of Leemooggoogoon, a primordial entity, or a trapped god — whose nature may hold the key to ending the schism.
source_quote: …where it is consumed by … something.
